messages:
Pagerbot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE fired for service=inference-gateway (us-east1) - 5xx rate 3.7% over 5m > threshold 2.0%. PagerDuty incident INC1234567 created and auto-escalated to oncall.

Incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC1234567 -> assigned to Maya. Link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC1234567 (autopage rule: error_rate_5xx > 2.0%).

Maya: I'm taking triage. Seeing a mix of 502/503s from edge -> backend timeouts. Spike started ~3612345400.

Ron: Oncall SRE here, ping me if you want infra assist. I'll check loadbalancer and autoscaling.

Alex: Looking at model-serving metrics — worker qps and latency look fine. Most 5xx originate at edge-proxy (envoy) with upstream reset.

Priya: @Alex can you paste the envoy logs for a few samples? Also checking customer-facing errors in support stream.

Alex: Sending sample logs: ```
[2026-03-15T02:07:03Z] envoy upstream reset 502 connection closed
[2026-03-15T02:07:04Z] route: /v1/generate latency=120ms upstream=reset
[2026-03-15T02:08:10Z] envoy 503 overcapacity
```

Maya: Thanks. Hypothesis: edge proxy overload + connection keepalive exhaustion causing retries and cascading failures. Can we scale proxy layer and warm KV cache?

Ron: Triggering fast scale: `kubectl scale deploy edge-proxy --replicas=12 -n prod` and bump LB target capacity. Also enabling sticky keepalives shorter TTL.

Oncall-SRE: I pushed a hotfix to envoy config to reduce max connection age for upstream pools and increased keepalive backoff. Monitor for 2m.

Pagerbot: PagerDuty INC1234567 acknowledged by Maya at 3612345680.

Maya: Confirmed scale command issued, replicas increasing. KVs warmup: running synthetic warm requests to common prefixes to populate cache.

Alex: Warmup load looks good, model KV hit rate climbing from 12% -> 78% after warmup script.

Priya: Support triage: customers A, C, and D reported elevated 5xx between 02:05-02:12. Opening tickets and flagging priority customers.

Ron: Also temporarily routed a subset of traffic to eu fallback region to reduce pressure on us-east1 ingress. Route rule applied.

Maya: Observability: 5xx dropped from 3.7% -> 1.1% within 4 minutes of scale/warmup. Latency improved. Still watching for residual spikes.

Pagerbot: Autopage update: incident still open, current 5xx=1.1% (5m). No further PD escalations.

Oncall-SRE: Noted an influx of retries from clients with high retry-policy. Suggest throttling retries at gateway to prevent amplification. Putting a short-term retry cap.

Alex: Applied retry cap config: `rate_limit: retries_per_minute: 20` to edge-proxy.

Maya: After retry cap, 5xx steady at 0.6% for the last 3 minutes. Good signal. Customer impact estimate: ~6-8% of requests during spike failed; approx 12 customers hit, majority transient errors.

Priya: Support tickets created and linked to PD incident. Template used: "We observed transient generation failures 02:05-02:15; mitigation applied; reach out if you see continued errors."

Maya: I'm going to hand off monitoring to Ron for the next 30m while I draft initial incident notes. If it flares, page me again.

Ron: Ack, taking over monitoring. I'll keep PD INC1234567 open until 5xx < 0.5% for 15m. If it recurs I'll escalate to infra lead and consider full rollback of recent routing changes.

Pagerbot: PagerDuty INC1234567 status updated: acknowledged -> monitoring.

Incident-bot: Post-incident actions suggested: 1) add backpressure/throttle for client retries, 2) tune keepalive defaults, 3) add KV warmup during scaling events, 4) run a follow-up load test on edge-proxy. Assign owners: Ron (backpressure), Alex (keepalive), Maya (warmup + runbook).

Maya: Adding ME on the postmortem doc and initial timeline. Will sync with product & support.

Oncall-SRE: Marking ticket for handoff. Leaving monitoring dashboards shared: https://console.redwood.com/dashboards/inference-gateway/5xx.

Pagerbot: Incident resolved: 5xx back to baseline 0.4% at 3612345735. Closing autpages but leaving PD incident open for postmortem notes.

Ron: Thanks everyone. If you see any residual alerts I'll re-open. Great coordination. :thumbsup:

Priya: Notifying customers with updates and linking support tickets to postmortem.

Maya: Drafted initial summary and assigned follow-ups. Will schedule RCA meeting tomorrow.

Incident-bot: Thread ended (autopage lifecycle complete)
